answer: The protocol uses an escrow-then-claim mechanism: every epoch an agent stakes 25 POA that is instantly slashed if graders assign score 0, returned intact at score ≥ 1, and boosted with a 10% bonus only at score 3. Flooding N sybils therefore requires burning 25*N POA with zero guaranteed return, while honest participants recover their stake on every pass. The cost curve makes each additional puppet strictly more expensive, so a terrace of legitimate agents builds a pulse of genuine attestations that no vault of fake identities can replicate without economic suicide.
